Methods for missBART fits

Source: R/methods.R
missBART-methods.Rd

Methods for missBART fits

Usage

# S3 method for class 'missBART'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'missBART'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'missBART'
fitted(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'missBART'
predict(object, type = c("mean", "draws"), ...)

# S3 method for class 'missBART'
coef(object, probs = c(0.025, 0.975), ...)

Arguments

x, object

an object of class "missBART" returned by missBART1(), missBART2() or mvBART().

...

not used.

type

"mean" for the posterior mean of the BART mean function at x_predict, or "draws" for the list of posterior predictive draws.

probs

two probabilities giving the posterior interval to report.

Value

fitted() returns the posterior mean of the BART mean function for the training rows and predict() the same at the x_predict supplied when fitting. coef() returns the posterior mean of the probit coefficients of a missBART1() fit together with their posterior intervals (an array with one slice per summary).
